definition.exclusion_mechanism: pandas .shift(1) applied to the per-ticker series BEFORE the .rolling(20, min_periods=10) call, so the window used for date T's mean/std spans dates strictly before T (never including T)
definition.standard_deviation_convention: pandas .rolling().std() default: sample standard deviation, ddof=1
definition.grouping: per-ticker (each ETF is z-scored against only its OWN trailing history, never pooled across ETFs)
definition.null_handling: z is NaN whenever fewer than 10 prior observations exist (first ~10 sessions per ticker) or when rolling_std is exactly 0 (constant prior window); NaN/inf values are never zero-filled or imputed
definition.winsorization: none applied anywhere in the frozen definition
definition.verbatim_copy_note: This is a byte-for-byte copy of _zscore()/Z_WINDOW/Z_MIN_PERIODS from scripts/run_options_flow_signal_design_v2.py at commit 19dc02c. v3's implementation must call this exact logic, not a reinterpretation.

expected_direction_from_v2_recorded_befo.interpretation: Higher z_gross_premium_20d (today's gross options premium is elevated relative to that ETF's own trailing 20-session baseline) is expected to be followed by HIGHER forward returns (Q5 mean > Q1 mean at every horizon).

v2_discovery_sample_results.sample: 60 sessions x 6 ETFs = 360 rows, 2026-06-26 to 2026-09-21 (the existing Phase 1 full_flow window)
v2_discovery_sample_results.cross_etf_date_clustering_caveat: quintile-5 bucket: 60 rows across only 34 unique calendar dates (~1.76 rows/date) -- flagged in v2 as a reason 6/6 ETF agreement may partly reflect shared macro-calendar dates, not independent confirmation. This is exactly what v3's date-clustered inference (panel regression clustered by market_date, date-block bootstrap, date-level portfolio test) is designed to resolve.

sample_composition_plan.rule: The PRIMARY validation verdict is based ONLY on the 192 newly backfilled validation sessions (their own trailing-20D z-score baselines are built from the 20 warmup sessions immediately preceding them, never from the discovery-sample sessions). The 60-day discovery sample is reported separately, never merged into the primary significance test. The 252-session combined view is descriptive only, never presented as an out-of-sample result in itself.

prohibited_during_primary_validation: peeking at partial validation results while the backfill is still running
